name: Down the Scarlet Path

chain: In the Name of the Light

summary: At Nijel's Point, Brother Anton calls on you to prove your allegiance to the Scarlet Crusade.

sections.title: Proof of Allegiance
sections.body: Brother Anton says the Scourge must be stopped before it swallows the land and casts the world into darkness. The Scarlet Crusade has pledged itself to that fight. To prove your courage and allegiance, destroy thirty undead ravagers in the Valley of Bones, south of Anton. Succeed, and the Crusade will welcome you.

faq.q: Who asks you to destroy the undead ravagers?
aliases: who gives down the scarlet path
faq.answer: Brother Anton of the Scarlet Crusade asks you at Nijel's Point.

faq.q: Where are the undead ravagers found?
faq.answer: The undead ravagers are in the Valley of Bones, south of Nijel's Point in Desolace.

faq.q: Why does Brother Anton want the ravagers destroyed?
faq.answer: Brother Anton says the Crusade fights the Scourge, which corrupts people and infects the land. He asks you to prove your allegiance.

faq.q: How many ravagers must be destroyed?

aliases: prerequisite for down the scarlet path
